title: NHKマイルCの後に・リトル誤算

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Nooo! Have I fallen off my destined path? I should've won this. I thought it was a matter of fact that I would…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But I guess there's no such thing as a guaranteed win. At least this was a good learning experience.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And I can keep going forward using what I've learned from this race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl didn't win the race, but she still displayed a formidable amount of strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterwards, I decide to talk to her about the future.
choice_data_list: Where will you be running next?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: On the international stage!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Is it? I was thinking of making up for today's loss by grabbing a win in an international race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Trying to take on a European G1 right now would be rushing things…
choice_data_list: You still need to build up the necessary strength to do that.
You still need to build up the necessary strength to do that.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The necessary strength, huh? Where am I supposed to go to do that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, I already know the answer to that. This may be a surprising suggestion, but…
choice_data_list: How about taking on the Shuka Sho?
How about taking on the Shuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The Shuka Sho? I know it's the last race in the Triple Tiara, but doesn't it also measure 2,000 meters long?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I thought we decided miles were the best for me…
choice_data_list: Sure, but you need to build up more stamina.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Why?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oh! You mean for the European turf! I see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As always, Seeking the Pearl catches on quick.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she wants to run a European mile race, she'll need more endurance than is required to run a mile on familiar turf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she doesn't train up her stamina to give herself some breathing room, she won't be able to run through the end of a race on deep turf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's why I want her to build up enough stamina to run domestic 2,000-meter races. But not only that…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Well, hang on. If it's 2,000 meters, I might just be able to win it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And if I run in the Shuka Sho, I might get to reunite with a member of the Pearl family. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Dober, of course. Mejiro Dober. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Settling things with Dober while she's on the Triple Tiara tour, then flying abroad afterwards sounds like a pretty great idea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober should be running in the Shuka Sho. She should be a lot more powerful than she was in her junior year too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And if Seeking the Pearl is really serious about beating her, I'd like her to run another race that's around the same distance before the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So are we going straight to the Shuka Sho?
choice_data_list: No, let's run in the Rose Stakes first.
No, let's run in the Rose Stakes first.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The Rose Stakes… A 1,800-meter G2 race… A lot of Umamusume run in it before the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The Rose Stakes, the Shuka Sho, and then the world! All right, now all my plans from the fall onwards are decided!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everything is going smoothly, and not a single shadow looms over us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally, Seeking the Pearl's vision of the future and the full picture of her classic year comes into clear view.
